existing_rules_reviewed.note: Reviewed for COTRTUPC only (the other cited programs belong to other batches). In 1230-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD, and likewise in 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD (921-928, 940-947, 958-965), 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW (799-803) and 9100-GET-TRANSACTION-TYPE (1492-1494, 1498-1508), the message is built only when WS-RETURN-MSG is still spaces, so the first failing edit's message is shown. Exceptions in this program: 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING and 9700-INSERT-RECORD build SQL error text unconditionally (1568-1577, 1608-1617).

Confirmed for COTRTUPC: after the description edit, if INPUT-ERROR is not set TTUP-CHANGE-ACTION becomes 'N' (validated, awaiting PF5). This point is reached only when a change versus the fetched values was detected (746-751).

Range spans 1210-EDIT-TRANTYPE (820-842) and 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD (907-973); the 1230-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD lines in between belong to BR-BASE-COTRTUPC-002. Required and non-zero are correct ('Tran Type code must be supplied.', 'Tran Type code must not be zero.'). Corrected on 'numeric': the test is FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL on the 2-character value (934-935), which also accepts a sign, a decimal point or trailing spaces (message 'Tran Type code must be numeric.'). A passing value is converted with NUMVAL into unsigned PIC 9(02) WS-EDIT-NUMERIC-2, so a sign or fraction is dropped (Inferred: '-5' becomes '05', '.5' becomes '00' after passing the non-zero test). The code is then rewritten with leading zeros (spaces replaced by zeros). The edit only runs when not in create-new or confirm state (712-717).

existing_rules_reviewed.anchor: ' can have numbers or alphabets only.'
existing_rules_reviewed.note: Invoked from 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS at 755-764. Description (TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE-DESC, length 50) must be non-blank ('Transaction Desc must be supplied.') and contain only A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and spaces ('Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only.'). The edit runs only when a change has been detected (746-751).

Range spans the skip decision in 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS (743-751) through 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW (783-811). Confirmed: type code compared upper-cased, description compared trimmed and upper-cased with equal trimmed length; if equal 'No change detected with respect to values fetched.' (only when no prior message) and the non-key edits are skipped (WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS cleared). Edits are also skipped when the state is already 'N' (validated) or 'C' (done). A case-only description change is therefore treated as no change.

no_rule_decisions.reason: Default flow (ENTER and other valid keys): receive and edit inputs, decide next state, send map. The decisions are documented in the paragraphs it performs.
State TTUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK retained (edit errors shown again); no transition.
State TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED retained until PF5 or PF12; no transition.
Chooses which values (blank, original fetched, or newly entered) are displayed per state; presentation only.
Maps the screen state to an information prompt text; message housekeeping (anomaly on TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS recorded in observations).
Field protection, cursor position and colour per state; presentation only.
Dark/bright attribute for the information message; presentation.
Highlights the PF key legends valid in the current state (mirror of 0001-CHECK-PFKEYS); presentation.

observations.text: Inferred: a failed save is reported as success. 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING (SQLCODE < 0) and 9700-INSERT-RECORD (insert failure) SET TABLE-UPDATE-FAILED and then STRING an SQL error text INTO WS-RETURN-MSG, overwriting the 88-level value 'Update of record failed'. The following EVALUATE (1580-1589) therefore no longer sees TABLE-UPDATE-FAILED and falls to WHEN OTHER, setting TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, so the info line shows 'Changes committed to database' alongside the SQL error.

Inferred: on DELETE SQLCODE -532 (child category rows exist) the state is left at TTUP-START-DELETE ('8') because only RECORD-DELETE-FAILED is set, not TTUP-DELETE-FAILED. That state is not handled by 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, so the next ENTER reaches WHEN OTHER and the task abends with 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'. The -532 message also concatenates SQLERRM twice.

Save is an upsert: UPDATE returning +100 triggers INSERT. Inferred: if the row was deleted by another user after it was displayed for change, saving silently re-creates it. DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE ('Record changed by some one else. Please review') is tested but never set, so no optimistic concurrency check is performed.
DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN is set to FUNCTION LENGTH of the 50-byte field TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE-DESC, i.e. always 50, so descriptions are stored padded with trailing spaces.
A SQL error on the key lookup (SQLCODE < 0) sets FLG-TRANFILTER-NOT-OK like 'not found'; 2000-DECIDE-ACTION then sets TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND and offers 'Press F05 to add. F12 to cancel'.

In 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG, WHEN TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS has no statements and shares the body of the next WHEN, so a fetched record is shown with 'Enter transaction type to be maintained' instead of FOUND-TRANTYPE-DATA ('Selected transaction type shown above'), which is never used.
ABEND-ROUTINE overwrites ABEND-CODE with '9999', so the '0001' code set for 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' in 2000-DECIDE-ACTION is lost.
PF5 is accepted as valid in any delete state (TTUP-DELETE-IN-PROGRESS) although no PF5 branch exists for those states; it falls through to the default input-processing path.

WHEN TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE AND CCARD-AID-PFK12 is unreachable because the earlier WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 (988) catches PF12 first. WS-INVALID-KEY (tested at 1026) is never set (its SET is commented out at 612).

Unused items: DCLTRCAT host structure (included at 288, no DCL-TRC reference), TTYP-UPDATE-RECORD, TTUP-REVIEW-NEW-RECORD, CODING-TO-BE-DONE, WS-NAME-MUST-BE-ALPHA, WS-EDIT-DATE-X and WS-EDIT-CURRENCY fields, COPY CSUTLDWY. WS-EDIT-DATE-X is also declared twice (108 and 115-116, the second REDEFINES itself).
3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES moves LOW-VALUES to TRTYPCDO twice; the description output field is not cleared there.
Comment says 'Read the Card file. Access via alternate index ACCTID' but the code is a DB2 SELECT on CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE by TR_TYPE.
RESP/RESP2 of RECEIVE MAP and RESP of SEND MAP are captured but never tested.
No check of the signed-on user's type; on PF3 the program sets CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN before XCTL.

paragraphs.logic: Sets HANDLE ABEND to ABEND-ROUTINE, initialises work areas and restores or initialises CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA (fresh start on first entry or when coming from COADM01C/COTRTLIC without re-enter). Maps the AID key, validates it for the current state, resets terminal states to a fresh search, then EVALUATEs: PF3 exit, fresh entry (send empty search screen), PF4 confirm delete / request delete, PF5 create-new or save, PF12 cancel, invalid key, or default input processing; ends at COMMON-RETURN.
paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN

paragraphs.logic: Moves WS-RETURN-MSG to CCARD-ERROR-MSG, packs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA into WS-COMMAREA and issues EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CTTU').
paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN

paragraphs.logic: Sets PFK-VALID for PF3 always, ENTER unless delete confirmation is pending, PF4 in show-details or confirm-delete, PF5 in validated, not-found or any delete state, PF12 in validated, show-details, not-found, confirm-delete or create-new. Otherwise PFK-INVALID and 'Invalid key pressed' if no message is set.
paragraphs.name: 0001-CHECK-PFKEYS

paragraphs.logic: Performs 1100-RECEIVE-MAP, 1150-STORE-MAP-IN-NEW and 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS, then sets CCARD-ERROR-MSG and next program/mapset/map to this program.
paragraphs.name: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS

paragraphs.logic: EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP CTRTUPA MAPSET COTRTUP INTO CTRTUPAI with RESP/RESP2 (not tested).
paragraphs.name: 1100-RECEIVE-MAP

paragraphs.logic: Unless the key was previously not found and is resent unchanged without PF5, initialises TTUP-NEW-DETAILS and stores the screen type code (TRTYPCDI) and description (TRTYDSCI), trimmed; '*' or spaces become LOW-VALUES.
paragraphs.name: 1150-STORE-MAP-IN-NEW

paragraphs.logic: If the not-found key is resent, marks the key valid and (unless PF5) sets details-not-fetched. Otherwise, outside create/validated states, edits the type code: blank gives 'No input received' and not-fetched, invalid gives TTUP-INVALID-SEARCH-KEYS. Then compares new versus old values; if changed, sets TTUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK, edits the description and, with no errors, sets TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED.
paragraphs.name: 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS

paragraphs.logic: Sets NO-CHANGES-FOUND; if type code (upper-cased) and description (trimmed, upper-cased, same length) match the fetched values, sets 'No change detected with respect to values fetched.' when no message exists; otherwise sets CHANGE-HAS-OCCURRED (only when no message exists).
paragraphs.name: 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW

paragraphs.logic: Edits TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE as 'Tran Type code' (length 2) via 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD and stores the result in WS-EDIT-TTYP-FLAG; if valid, normalises the code through NUMVAL into PIC 9(02) and writes it back with leading zeros.
paragraphs.name: 1210-EDIT-TRANTYPE

paragraphs.logic: Generic required alphanumeric edit: blank sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ALPHNANUM-BLANK and '<name> must be supplied.'; any character other than letters, digits or space sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ALPHNANUM-NOT-OK and '<name> can have numbers or alphabets only.'; otherwise FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID.
paragraphs.name: 1230-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD

paragraphs.logic: Generic required numeric edit: blank gives '<name> must be supplied.'; TEST-NUMVAL failure gives '<name> must be numeric.'; NUMVAL = 0 gives '<name> must not be zero.'; each sets INPUT-ERROR. Otherwise FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID.
paragraphs.name: 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD

paragraphs.logic: State machine on TTUP-CHANGE-ACTION: when details are not fetched or PF12, reads the type code from DB2 if the key is valid (show details or not found) or cancels a pending delete/update; show-details with good changes becomes validated; backed-out becomes changes-not-ok; PF5 on not-found becomes create-new; after a completed save returns to show-details and clears account context if there is no caller. Any other state abends with 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'.
paragraphs.name: 2000-DECIDE-ACTION

paragraphs.logic: Performs 3100-SCREEN-INIT, 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS, 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG, 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS, 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS, 3391-SETUP-PFKEY-ATTRS and 3400-SEND-SCREEN, each THRU its -EXIT paragraph.
paragraphs.name: 3000-SEND-MAP

paragraphs.logic: Clears CTRTUPAO and fills titles, transaction CTTU, program name, current date (MM/DD/YY) and time.
paragraphs.name: 3100-SCREEN-INIT

paragraphs.logic: Does nothing when CDEMO-PGM-ENTER. Otherwise TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED performs 3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES; TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS, TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE, TTUP-DELETE-FAILED, TTUP-DELETE-DONE, TTUP-CHANGES-BACKED-OUT and WHEN OTHER INITIALIZE TTUP-NEW-DETAILS and perform 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES; TTUP-CHANGES-MADE, TTUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK, TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND, TTUP-INVALID-SEARCH-KEYS, TTUP-CREATE-NEW-RECORD and TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE perform 3203-SHOW-UPDATED-VALUES.
paragraphs.name: 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS

paragraphs.logic: Clears WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS and shows TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE and TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE-DESC.
paragraphs.name: 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES

paragraphs.logic: Selects the info prompt from the state (search prompt, 'Press F05 to add. F12 to cancel', 'Update transaction type details shown.', 'Delete this record ? Press F4 to confirm', 'Delete successful.', 'Enter new transaction type details.', 'Changes validated.Press F5 to save', 'Changes committed to database', 'Changes unsuccessful'), centres it into INFOMSGO and moves WS-RETURN-MSG to ERRMSGO.
paragraphs.name: 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG

paragraphs.logic: Protects all fields, then unprotects the type code in search states or the description in show/change/create states; keeps all protected in validated, done and delete states. Positions the cursor, colours an invalid key or failed delete red, shows '*' in red for a blank key, and applies CSSETATY attributes to the description.
paragraphs.name: 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS

paragraphs.logic: Sets type code, description and info message attributes to protected (DFHBMPRF).
paragraphs.name: 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS

paragraphs.logic: Makes the description editable (DFHBMFSE) and keeps the info message protected.
paragraphs.name: 3320-UNPROTECT-FEW-ATTRS

paragraphs.logic: Sets INFOMSGA of CTRTUPAI to DFHBMDAR (dark) when WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE, otherwise to DFHBMASB (bright).
paragraphs.name: 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS

paragraphs.logic: Sets FKEYSA dark (DFHBMDAR) when TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE, else bright (DFHBMASB). Brightens FKEY04A for TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS or TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE; FKEY05A for TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED or TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND; FKEY12A for TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS, TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND, TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE or TTUP-CREATE-NEW-RECORD.
paragraphs.name: 3391-SETUP-PFKEY-ATTRS

paragraphs.logic: EXEC CICS SEND MAP CTRTUPA MAPSET COTRTUP FROM CTRTUPAO with CURSOR, ERASE, FREEKB.
paragraphs.name: 3400-SEND-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Clears old details and info message, performs 9100-GET-TRANSACTION-TYPE and, if the key was found (filter not NOT-OK), stores the fetched row via 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA.
paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-TRANTYPE

paragraphs.logic: SELECT TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE. 0 sets FOUND-TRANTYPE-IN-TABLE; +100 sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-TRANFILTER-NOT-OK, 'No record found for this key in database'; < 0 sets the same flags with 'Error accessing: TRANSACTION_TYPE table. SQLCODE:' plus SQLERRM.
paragraphs.name: 9100-GET-TRANSACTION-TYPE

paragraphs.logic: Stores DCL-TR-TYPE and the VARCHAR text (1:DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN) as TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE / TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE-DESC.
paragraphs.name: 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA

paragraphs.logic: UPDATE CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION = trimmed new description WHERE TR_TYPE = new code. 0: SYNCPOINT; +100: 9700-INSERT-RECORD; -911: INPUT-ERROR and 'Could not lock record for update'; < 0: SQL error text. Then sets the state to lock-error, failed, show-details or (otherwise) TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE.
paragraphs.name: 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING

paragraphs.logic: INSERT INTO CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE (TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION) from DCL host variables; 0: SYNCPOINT; otherwise TABLE-UPDATE-FAILED then 'Error inserting record into: TRANSACTION_TYPE Table. SQLCODE:' plus SQLERRM.
paragraphs.name: 9700-INSERT-RECORD

paragraphs.logic: DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE. 0: TTUP-DELETE-DONE and SYNCPOINT; -532: 'Please delete associated child records first:' with SQLCODE/SQLERRM; other: TTUP-DELETE-FAILED and 'Delete failed with message:' text.
paragraphs.name: 9800-DELETE-PROCESSING

paragraphs.logic: Exit paragraph for 9800-DELETE-PROCESSING; followed by COPY CSSTRPFY (YYYY-STORE-PFKEY).
paragraphs.name: 9800-DELETE-PROCESSING-EXIT

paragraphs.logic: Defaults ABEND-MSG to 'UNEXPECTED ABEND OCCURRED.', sets culprit COTRTUPC and code '9999', sends ABEND-DATA to the terminal, cancels HANDLE ABEND and issues EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999').
paragraphs.name: ABEND-ROUTINE

rules.conditions: PF12 with TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS/CREATE-NEW-RECORD/DETAILS-NOT-FOUND, or state C, L, F, 7, 6, or B with empty old details
messages: Enter transaction type to be maintained
rules.outcome: CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED; empty search screen sent.
rules.statement: After a completed or failed save, a completed or failed delete, a cancelled new-record entry (backed out with no fetched record), or PF12 while viewing details, creating a record or on a not-found key, the screen restarts as a fresh search (enter transaction type).
PF3 returns to the calling transaction/program from the commarea, or to the admin menu CA00 / COADM01C when none is recorded, after a CICS SYNCPOINT.

rules.outcome: PFK-VALID, or PFK-INVALID with 'Invalid key pressed' and screen resent.
rules.statement: Function keys are only accepted in the screen states where they make sense: PF3 always; ENTER except while a delete confirmation is pending; PF4 when a record is shown or delete confirmation is pending; PF5 when changes are validated, the key was not found, or a delete is in progress; PF12 when validated, showing details, not found, confirming delete or creating new. Any other key redisplays the screen with 'Invalid key pressed'.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-PFK04 AND TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS, then CCARD-AID-PFK04 AND TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE
messages: Delete this record ? Press F4 to confirm
rules.statement: Deleting a transaction type is two-step: PF4 on a displayed record asks 'Delete this record ? Press F4 to confirm'; a second PF4 in that state performs the DELETE.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND; later CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED
messages: Press F05 to add. F12 to cancel
rules.statement: When the entered transaction type code does not exist, the user may press PF5 to create it: the screen switches to new-record entry ('Enter new transaction type details.'); after the description passes validation, PF5 saves it.

PF12 cancels a pending action: cancelling a delete confirmation gives 'Delete was cancelled' and returns to the search prompt; cancelling validated changes gives 'Update was cancelled', restores the fetched values (backed out) and the next interaction returns to edit mode.

rules.outcome: TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE / TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE-DESC = LOW-VALUES, else FUNCTION TRIM(input).
rules.statement: Screen input of '*' or all spaces in the type code or description is treated as not supplied (LOW-VALUES); other input is trimmed. When a not-found key is resent unchanged without PF5, the previously entered values are kept.
If the key was not found and the user resends the same key: with PF5 the key is accepted for creation; otherwise the record is looked up again. Edits are skipped in both cases.

A transaction type code must be entered to search: blank input gives 'No input received' and stays on the search prompt; a code failing the numeric edit marks the search key invalid. The key edit is skipped in create-new and validated states.
A valid search key is looked up in TRANSACTION_TYPE: if found the record is displayed for change or delete, otherwise the user is offered to add it.

rules.conditions: TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS AND NOT (INPUT-ERROR OR NO-CHANGES-DETECTED OR WS-INVALID-KEY)
rules.statement: When a displayed record has been changed and passes all edits, the program asks for confirmation ('Changes validated.Press F5 to save') instead of saving immediately; edit errors or no detected change keep the record in edit mode.
After a successful save the record is shown again; if the program was not entered from another transaction, the account context in the commarea (account id, card number, account status) is cleared.

rules.conditions: WHEN OTHER in 2000-DECIDE-ACTION (or any CICS abend via HANDLE ABEND)
rules.outcome: ABEND-ROUTINE: EXEC CICS SEND ABEND-DATA, HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999').
rules.statement: Any screen state not handled by the decision logic is treated as a program error: the task sends the abend data ('UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO') to the terminal and abends with code 9999.

messages: No record found for this key in database
rules.statement: A transaction type code that does not exist in TRANSACTION_TYPE is reported as 'No record found for this key in database'; a SQL error on the lookup is reported with the SQLCODE and SQLERRM. Both mark the key as not OK.

messages: Could not lock record for update
rules.outcome: SYNCPOINT on success; INPUT-ERROR on -911; error message otherwise.
rules.statement: Saving is an upsert: the description is UPDATEd by TR_TYPE; if no row exists (+100) the row is INSERTed. A successful update or insert is committed with CICS SYNCPOINT. Deadlock/timeout (-911) gives 'Could not lock record for update'; other negative SQLCODEs give 'Error updating: TRANSACTION_TYPE Table. SQLCODE:...' and insert failures 'Error inserting record into: TRANSACTION_TYPE Table. SQLCODE:...'.

The outcome of a save sets the next screen state: lock failure shows 'Changes unsuccessful' (lock error), a flagged update failure shows 'Changes unsuccessful' (failed), a concurrent-change condition returns to show details, and anything else is treated as committed ('Changes committed to database'). Inferred: because the failure flag is overwritten by the SQL error text, SQL failures also reach the committed state (see observation).

rules.conditions: DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE
messages: Please delete associated child records first:
rules.outcome: 0: TTUP-DELETE-DONE + SYNCPOINT; -532: RECORD-DELETE-FAILED + message; other: TTUP-DELETE-FAILED + message.
rules.statement: A confirmed delete removes the transaction type by its fetched code and commits (CICS SYNCPOINT, 'Delete successful.'). If category rows still reference it (SQLCODE -532, foreign key ON DELETE RESTRICT) the message 'Please delete associated child records first:' with SQLCODE and SQLERRM is shown; any other failure sets delete-failed with 'Delete failed with message:'.

sme_questions.question: Should a failed UPDATE/INSERT really end in the 'Changes committed to database' state? The SQL error text overwrites the TABLE-UPDATE-FAILED flag before the state is evaluated.
After a -532 delete failure the state stays '8' (start delete), which leads to the 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' abend on the next ENTER. Should -532 also set TTUP-DELETE-FAILED?
Is the save-as-upsert intended for updates of an existing record that another user deleted meanwhile, and was an optimistic concurrency check (DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE) planned?
Should type codes with a sign or decimal point (accepted by TEST-NUMVAL) be rejected rather than normalised to two unsigned digits?
Should a SQL error on the key lookup be distinguished from 'not found' so that the user is not offered to add the record?

summary.text: COTRTUPC is a pseudo-conversational CICS/DB2 program (transaction CTTU, map CTRTUPA in mapset COTRTUP) for maintaining a single row of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE. The user enters a 2-digit transaction type code; the program SELECTs it and either shows the description for change (PF4 to delete) or, if not found, offers PF5 to add a new type. Changed descriptions are validated (required, letters/digits/spaces only, must differ from the fetched value) and saved on PF5 confirmation as an UPDATE, or an INSERT when no row exists; deletes require a second PF4 and report the foreign-key restriction (-532) from TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY. Every successful change is committed with CICS SYNCPOINT, PF12 cancels a pending action and PF3 returns to the caller or the admin menu COADM01C. Screen state is held in TTUP-CHANGE-ACTION within the commarea appended to CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, and unexpected states end in an ABEND with code 9999.
